target.hardware: one a2-ultragpu-4g with four NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs

rates_and_ceiling.billing_note: Rate is repository-recorded full-rate arithmetic, not a settled quote. Stop before the ceiling.

memory_contract.bf16_reason: The 495.382 GiB source payload cannot reside on four 80GB ranks at source precision.
memory_contract.bounded_bf16_plan: Replay one restored BF16 layer/component at a time on captured matched inputs; never label this full-model BF16 generation.

artifact_contract.compression: zlib-6 chunks in v1; benchmark zstd before any format revision
artifact_contract.rank_layout: one independently checksummed artifact per TP rank plus a complete rank-set manifest
artifact_contract.partial_policy: Any absent rank, barrier failure, corrupt chunk, or alignment mismatch remains partial/corrupt and cannot be promoted.

stages.name: offline-contract-and-fixture-gate
stages.capture: Schemas, selector preflight, artifact corruption/rank tests, intervention isolation, analyses, patch application.

stages.name: tp4-observation-equivalence-smoke
stages.capture: All-layer router selection; layers 2,10,20,30,41 residual/attention/MLP statistics; top-10 decoder confidence.
stages.promotion_gate: Exact token ids, step logprobs, finish reason, and response-text hash match every untreated control; four complete aligned ranks; overhead <25%.

stages.name: matched-phenomenon-pilot
stages.capture: Router stats on all 40 MoE layers; rich tensors on candidate layers selected only from half of probes; confidence/KV trajectories.

layer_sampling.token_sampling: all generated tokens <=64; stratified 64 prompt positions

stages.promotion_gate: Candidate effects replicate in held-out ProbeSet groups after Benjamini-Hochberg correction; no train/held-out group leakage.

stages.name: quantization-fidelity-and-first-divergence
stages.capture: Matched W8A16 traces plus one-at-a-time BF16 replay at first-divergence candidates; logits/routes/margins/residual drift/verifier linkage.
stages.promotion_gate: Requests are token-identical; first divergence localized; numerical noise separated from route-flip cascades; component restoration stays above 6 GiB driver-free headroom.

stages.name: causal-tracing-and-interventions
stages.capture: Expert knockout/attenuation/reroute, activation patching, output ablation, steering, and selected precision restoration with fresh matched controls.
stages.promotion_gate: Treatment lease cleanup passes; effect CI excludes zero on held-out pairs; verifier regressions and unrelated capability guardrails remain within preregistered limits.

stages.name: long-context-trajectories
stages.capture: Statistics-only router, residual projection, KV/block metadata, and confidence at stratified prompt positions; no full residual tensors.
stages.promotion_gate: No telemetry OOM, silent drop, rank skew, or >30% latency overhead; retrieval and integration remain separately verified.

global_stop_conditions: Any output difference in stage 1 observation-only controls.
Any unpinned runtime, kernel, image, checkpoint, conversion, prompt, or profile identity.
Any TP rank missing, duplicated, misaligned, or failing either barrier.
Any telemetry artifact budget, spool capacity, or 500 GiB raw campaign ceiling breach.
Any rank below 6 GiB driver-free memory or above 73 GiB peak reserved memory.
Any non-finite activation/logit, CUDA OOM, kernel fallback, generation error, or corrupt chunk.
Any treatment hook remaining active when a control starts or failing exact parameter restoration.
Any image/audio request before the corresponding validation capability is GPU-validated.
Any compute arithmetic reaching the authorized dollar ceiling.
explicitly_deferred: Full end-to-end BF16 generation on TP4.
Image/audio encoder or projection claims until Multimodal Validation publishes supported paths.
Cloud provisioning, image publication, endpoint mutation, or paid execution without new explicit authorization.
